reviews.author: Ben Sweeney
reviews.text: Absolute Highlight of Our Trip!We had an amazing time during our first-ever surfing lesson with Dino and his team at Izzy School of Surf. From the moment we arrived, they were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and reassuring for beginners like us.The instructors gave excellent guidance, and thanks to their patience and helpful tips, we all managed to stand up on our boards! It was so much fun and an unforgettable experience.On top of the fantastic coaching, the lesson was very reasonably priced. If you are looking to learn how to surf in Lombok, we highly recommend Dino and his crew.

reviews.author: FluksFactory
reviews.text: Yus is a great teacher and great guy! Great hospitality, really made us feel like locals with some of his friends, drank coffee and just chat about the island. Recommend it to anyone who wants to try surfing! The next day I have also went fishing which ended up with a lunch with him and his brother, great experience aswell!

reviews.author: Leo Woerner
reviews.text: Perfect experience! I had my first-ever surf lesson and enjoyed it so much that I came back a dozen times. I started on a soft-top and got coached all the way to a 7 ft hardboard. Yus and his brother Farel are great guys: always positive and relaxed, while making you feel safe at all times. They went from being my surf instructors to becoming good friends. Bonus tip: Yus knows everyone, so ask him for recommendations if you need a scooter, laundry or anything else. Highly recommend, and I can't wait to come back for more surfing and kopi afterwards 🙌🏻

reviews.author: Keith Warner
reviews.text: Yus is a very friendly and energetic instructor and wonderful at guiding us. The location is great for beginner surfing. Would definately recommened. If you're in the area, do come down 🏄‍♂️

reviews.author: Rob de Groot
reviews.text: Great experience! We went with our two kids (8 and 6 years old) and had an amazing time. The waves were perfect for beginners, and Yus and his team were incredibly friendly, patient, and encouraging. They gave us plenty of personal attention and helped us improve our surfing step by step. Highly recommended for families and anyone wanting to learn to surf!
